defects.what: Usman has both ears folded (Labrador-like head), the same drift as k52/k60; the sheet says one folded ear.
defects.where: centre, the dog's head

refuted.why: At 3x Usman has one ear flopped sideways and one upright, which matches the one-folded-ear sheet; white chest patch and red kerchief present, he reads as the same dog.
Side by side with k22/k69 at 3x Indio has the same grey-streaked topknot, brown skin, long dark coat and wrist handkerchief; the smile softens the face but he is clearly recognisable.
At 3x the children in the lower right are separate, readable figures standing in front of the giant's arm; no merged bodies visible on a paused phone.
